_doc: EventBridge cron expressions (UTC) for keeping the GradFiT endpoint warm during peak hours. Adjust the cron strings before applying via Terraform or `aws events put-rule`.

rules.name: gradfit-warmup-india-evening
rules.description: Wake the endpoint 5 minutes before peak Indian browsing window (8:30pm-12am IST).
rules.comment: Triggers daily at 14:25 UTC = 19:55 IST (5min lead-in).

rules.name: gradfit-warmup-us-evening
rules.description: Wake before US East prime time (7pm-11pm ET).
rules.comment: Triggers daily at 22:55 UTC = 18:55 ET (5min lead-in).

rules.name: gradfit-keepalive-ping
rules.description: Send a /ping every 10 minutes during the active windows so SageMaker autoscaler does not drop to zero mid-session.
rules.comment: Lambda checks active window in code and short-circuits outside peak hours.
